facebook.caption: POV: you're vegetarian in Phu Quoc and everyone else is eating seafood. Then you find Maa Vegetarian Indian Restaurant inside Grand World Phú Quốc. 100% pure veg. 4.7 stars across 1,426 reviews. Dal, curry, paneer, proper Indian cooking, not an afterthought menu. Budget around $15-30 a head. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
